text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: P0 - embeddings-service 5xx spike detected, paging oncall-sre rotation. Incident link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4821 :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Alert details: surge started at 23:14 UTC, ~40% 503s, error traces show upstream connect failures to kv-cache node set.
Nadia: I'm still on shift, was driving this one. Quick state: we scaled replicas x2, flushed local prefix cache, partial improvement but tail latency still high. Leaving a short audit below.
Nadia: Runbook I used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-5xx (see section "kv-cache reconnect")
Nadia: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T23:12:03Z embeddings-svc pod-7f2 ERROR upstream connect failed: dial tcp 10.12.3.45:11211: connection refused
2026-03-14T23:12:09Z embeddings-svc pod-7f2 WARN cache miss spike, falling back to cpu path
```
Nadia: I'm handing off driver to Sam, leaving comms to Priya. Liam you can remain secondary for metric checks.
Sam: I got it, taking driver. First actions: 1) verify autoscaler health, 2) check kv-cache node pool, 3) toggle fallback route if needed.
Sam: Running quick health curl to pods: `kubectl get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide` and `curl -sS http://embeddings.internal/health | jq .`
Priya: Copy that — I'll draft the incident status for customers (short) and post to status.redwood while we triage. Draft: "We are investigating elevated error rates for embeddings; degraded responses for some requests. We're actively mitigating. Updates every 15m." Thoughts?
Liam: I'll keep an eye on latency SLOs dashboard and watch for error correlation with specific regions. If we see EU spike only we'll route traffic to US.
Sam: First check results: autoscaler controller shows currentReplicas=6 desired=6, no scale events in last 10m. kv-cache nodes show 2/4 Ready, one node NotReady in eu-west1. Suspect networking flake between eu-west1 memcached cluster.
Sam: Plan: rehome embeddings pods away from eu-west1 temporarily, set extra border routing to us-west1 for read-heavy traffic. Rolling restart of affected pods after draining node.
Nadia: For handoff checklist: mark driver explicitly, comms owner, leave links to runbook and metric dashboards, and call out any outstanding mitigation that needs follow-through.
Priya: Posting initial customer message now. I'll include next ETA: 15m for next update.
Priya: Posted: https://status.redwood.com/incident/INC-4821-update1 (short text attached).
Liam: I queued a temporary route rule: `route override embeddings -> us-west1` for 20m, monitoring for error fall.
Sam: Executing cordon/drain on affected node: `kubectl cordon node/ip-10-12-3-45` then `kubectl drain node/ip-10-12-3-45 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`
Sam: Rolling restart triggered; new pods starting, initial health checks passing. Error rate dropped from 40% to ~8% over 3 minutes.
Priya: Noted. Updating customer message: "Errors reduced; partial mitigation in place. Investigation continues to restore full capacity."
Nadia: Thanks team. Outgoing notes: leave follow-ups: 1) open a ticket with infra to repair eu-west1 memcached nodes, 2) check whether recent memcached config change rolled out yesterday, 3) add a small runbook step to auto-failover node pool earlier.
Sam: I'll stay online as driver for the next 30m to confirm stabilization then pass back to Nadia or next oncall. Priya will remain comms until we downgrade severity.
oncall-bot: Incident severity remains P0 until sustained error rate <1% for 10m.
Priya: I'll keep sending updates every 15m. Next update ~23:45 UTC.
Liam: I'll monitor for any regression and watch alerts for the kv cluster.
Sam: Handoff plan in 30m: if error <1% and metrics stable, I'll mark stable and hand back to Nadia for post-incident follow-up. If not, escalate to infra team oncall.
Priya: acknowledged, documenting current owners in incident doc.
SRE-runbooks-bot: Reminder: add postmortem checklist to incident doc and assign action owners (infra-ticket, runbook update).
Nadia: Thanks all — handing over full driver to Sam now. Leaving: few notes in doc under "handoff" section. Good luck. :thumbsup:
Sam: Taking driver. Thanks Nadia, noted on notes.
Priya: Thanks Nadia — taking comms.
Liam: Copy, standing by.
oncall-bot: Update: error rate at 23:34 UTC is 7.9% (was 40%). Continuing monitoring.
